description: Phase 1 5,000-step pilot convergence sweep across 7 core models (Conformer Tiny/Small/Base GE2E, ECAPA-TDNN Small GE2E, ResNet-18 Small GE2E, Conformer Small ArcFace & SphereFace), plus 500-step angular-margin warm-up ablations, standalone cosine LR schedule horizon controls, and exact Phase 2 step budgets and wall-clock runtime projections for all 44 models.

capacity_scaling_comparison.domain_analysis: On LibriSpeech (232 train speakers, 5,788 utterances), the 400-step capacity inversion (Released 400-step: Base 15.37% > Tiny 13.23% > Small 12.50%; Step-400 of T_max=5000: Base 18.47% > Tiny 16.90% > Small 16.73%) completely resolves by step 4,500 to monotonic capacity ordering: Base (8.43%) < Small (8.70% at 4500 / 8.57% at 5000) < Tiny (8.87% at 4500 / 8.67% at 5000). On VoxCeleb1 (only 30 train speakers and 750 utterances in Universal), Tiny (19.60%) < Small (21.00%) < Base (22.75%) due to the 30-speaker bottle-neck.

phase2_recommended_step_budgets.rule: S_safe = X + 2 epochs (+600 steps on Universal [295.22 steps/epoch], +400 steps on LibriSpeech [180.88 steps/epoch], +200 steps on CN-Celeb2 [90.91 steps/epoch], +100 steps on VoxCeleb1 [23.44 steps/epoch])

group_1_angular_margin_classifiers.rationale: 381-class angular margin losses on Universal are severely under-converged at 400 steps (25.09% EER) and cross over GE2E around step 1,200-1,600, reaching 14.64%-14.82% at X=3,500 steps (S_safe=4,100) and 14.20% at X=4,000 steps (S_safe=4,600) with 500-step linear margin warm-up. Single-domain LibriSpeech (232 classes) uses S_safe=2,000-2,400 (warmup=300) and CN-Celeb2 (119 classes) uses S_safe=1,600-1,800 (warmup=250).

group_2_metric_learning_1d_backbones.rationale: Standalone cosine schedule calibration proves S_safe=3,000 (X=2,400+600) reaches 16.52% Pooled 1-utt EER (12.70% 3-utt, 21.27% Vox1-O) and S_safe=2,000 (X=1,400+600) reaches 17.48% Pooled 1-utt EER, while full 4,600-5,000 step training reaches 15.40%-16.25%.

group_3_conformer_base_and_2d_resnet.rationale: ResNet-18 Small drops from 27.89% (released 400-step) / 26.49% (step 400 of T_max=5000) Pooled 1-utt EER to 18.82% at X=1,600 steps (S_safe=2,200), 16.81% at X=3,000 (S_safe=3,600), and 16.00% at X=4,500 (S_safe=5,100). Conformer-Base resolves the LibriSpeech capacity inversion (8.43% < 8.57% Small < 8.67% Tiny) at X=4,000-4,500 (S_safe=4,600-5,100).

phase2_44_model_runtime_projections.hardware: AMD EPYC 7B13 (64 vCPUs / 32 physical cores across 4 CCDs, 8 physical cores per CCD)
